name: Measure Becoming Velocity
description: Quantifies the rate and quality of system evolution by measuring: change velocity (how fast), learning depth (how well), emergence indicators (what's new), autonomy growth (how independent), and potential energy (capacity for future growth). Provides a comprehensive 'speed of becoming' metric.

task_steps.description: Quantify rate of change across multiple dimensions

prompt.template:
Measure velocity of change across all system dimensions:

## 1. Execution Velocity

```bash
# Calculate execution frequency over time windows
jq -s '
  map(select(.estimated_metrics.execution_count > 0)) | {
    # Total execution rate
    total_executions: map(.estimated_metrics.execution_count) | add,
    execution_rate_per_week: (map(.estimated_metrics.execution_count) | add) / 13,  # 90 days ≈ 13 weeks
    
    # Active template velocity
    active_templates: length,
    avg_executions_per_template: (map(.estimated_metrics.execution_count) | add) / length,
    
    # High-frequency templates (>10 executions)
    high_frequency_count: map(select(.estimated_metrics.execution_count > 10)) | length,
    
    # Execution distribution
    execution_distribution: {
      intensive: map(select(.estimated_metrics.execution_count > 20)) | length,
      moderate: map(select(.estimated_metrics.execution_count >= 5 and .estimated_metrics.execution_count <= 20)) | length,
      experimental: map(select(.estimated_metrics.execution_count > 0 and .estimated_metrics.execution_count < 5)) | length
    }
  }
' ~/.metabob/activities/*.json > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/execution-velocity.json
```

## 2. Template Evolution Velocity

```bash
# Measure template creation and modification rate
cd ~/.metabob/activities

# Templates created in last 30 days
find . -name "*.json" -mtime -30 | wc -l > /tmp/new_templates_30d.txt

# Templates modified in last 30 days
find . -name "*.json" -mtime -30 -type f | wc -l > /tmp/modified_templates_30d.txt

# Template churn rate
git log --since="30 days ago" --oneline -- *.json | wc -l > /tmp/template_commits_30d.txt

jq -n --arg new "$(cat /tmp/new_templates_30d.txt)" \
      --arg mod "$(cat /tmp/modified_templates_30d.txt)" \
      --arg commits "$(cat /tmp/template_commits_30d.txt)" '
  {
    new_templates_30d: ($new | tonumber),
    modified_templates_30d: ($mod | tonumber),
    template_commits_30d: ($commits | tonumber),
    template_churn_rate: (($commits | tonumber) / 30)  # commits per day
  }
' > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/template-evolution-velocity.json
```

## 3. Success Rate Velocity

```bash
# How fast are templates improving?
jq -s '
  map(select(.estimated_metrics.execution_count >= 5)) | 
  map(select(.estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient)) | {
    # Average improvement rate across all templates
    avg_improvement_gradient: (map(.estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient) | add / length),
    
    # Fastest improvers
    fastest_improvers: (sort_by(-.estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient) | .[0:3] | map({
      id: .id,
      gradient: .estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient,
      current_success: .estimated_metrics.success_rate
    })),
    
    # Templates accelerating (positive gradient trend)
    accelerating_count: map(select(.estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient > 0.05)) | length,
    
    # System-wide success velocity (percentage points per week)
    system_success_velocity: (map(.estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient) | add / length) * 100
  }
' ~/.metabob/activities/*.json > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/success-velocity.json
```

## 4. Cost Optimization Velocity

```bash
# How fast is cost decreasing?
jq -s '
  map(select(.estimated_metrics.execution_count >= 5)) | {
    # Current cost baseline
    avg_cost: (map(.estimated_metrics.avg_cost) | add / length),
    
    # Estimated cost reduction rate (assuming 10% per cycle if improving)
    improving_templates: map(select(.estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient > 0)) | length,
    cost_reduction_velocity: (
      (map(select(.estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient > 0)) | length) / length * 0.10  # 10% reduction for improving templates
    ),
    
    # Templates achieving cost targets (<$0.10)
    cost_efficient_templates: map(select(.estimated_metrics.avg_cost <= 0.10)) | length,
    cost_efficiency_rate: (map(select(.estimated_metrics.avg_cost <= 0.10)) | length) / length * 100
  }
' ~/.metabob/activities/*.json > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/cost-velocity.json
```

## 5. Aggregate Velocity Metrics

```bash
jq -s '{
  execution_velocity: .[0],
  template_evolution_velocity: .[1],
  success_velocity: .[2],
  cost_velocity: .[3],
  
  # Composite velocity score (0-100)
  composite_velocity_score: (
    # Weighted combination
    (.[0].execution_rate_per_week / 50 * 25) +  # Execution velocity (25%)
    (.[1].template_churn_rate * 3.33 * 15) +    # Evolution velocity (15%)
    (.[2].system_success_velocity * 30) +        # Success velocity (30%)
    (.[3].cost_reduction_velocity * 100 * 30)    # Cost velocity (30%)
  ) | if . > 100 then 100 else . end
}' $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/execution-velocity.json \
   $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/template-evolution-velocity.json \
   $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/success-velocity.json \
   $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/cost-velocity.json > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/change-velocity.json
```

## Output

$ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/change-velocity.json with all velocity measurements

task_steps.description: Assess quality and depth of learning

prompt.template:
Measure learning depth and quality:

## 1. Pattern Recognition Depth

```bash
# Count documented failure patterns
find ~/.metabob/activities -name "*.json" -exec jq -r '.estimated_metrics.failure_patterns // [] | length' {} \; | 
  awk '{sum+=$1; count++} END {print sum, count, sum/count}' > /tmp/failure_patterns_stats.txt

jq -n --arg stats "$(cat /tmp/failure_patterns_stats.txt)" '
  $stats | split(" ") | {
    total_patterns_documented: (.[0] | tonumber),
    templates_with_patterns: (.[1] | tonumber),
    avg_patterns_per_template: (.[2] | tonumber),
    pattern_diversity_score: ((.[0] | tonumber) / (.[1] | tonumber) * 10)  # More patterns = deeper learning
  }
' > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/pattern-recognition.json
```

## 2. Adaptation Sophistication

```bash
# Measure how well templates adapt to failures
jq -s '
  map(select(.estimated_metrics.execution_count > 0)) | {
    # Templates with retry strategies
    templates_with_retry: map(select(.task_steps[].retry.max_attempts > 1)) | length,
    
    # Templates with validation
    templates_with_validation: map(select(.task_steps[].validation.required_patterns | length > 0)) | length,
    
    # Templates with multiple strategies (variants)
    templates_with_variants: map(select(.id | endswith("-v2") or endswith("-v3") or endswith("-fixed"))) | length,
    
    # Sophistication score
    adaptation_sophistication: (
      (map(select(.task_steps[].retry.max_attempts > 1)) | length) / length * 30 +
      (map(select(.task_steps[].validation.required_patterns | length > 0)) | length) / length * 40 +
      (map(select(.id | endswith("-v2") or endswith("-v3") or endswith("-fixed"))) | length) / length * 30
    )
  }
' ~/.metabob/activities/*.json > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/adaptation-sophistication.json
```

## 3. Knowledge Accumulation

```bash
# Measure accumulation of reusable knowledge
jq -s '
  {
    # Total reusable components
    total_templates: length,
    total_task_steps: (map(.task_steps | length) | add),
    
    # Documented learnings (annotations via metabob)
    templates_with_metabob: map(select(.metabob.enabled == true)) | length,
    
    # Template composition (templates using other templates)
    composite_templates: map(select(.task_steps[].prompt.template | contains("activity"))) | length,
    
    # Knowledge density
    avg_tasks_per_template: (map(.task_steps | length) | add) / length,
    knowledge_reuse_score: (
      (map(select(.task_steps[].prompt.template | contains("activity"))) | length) / length * 100
    )
  }
' ~/.metabob/activities/*.json > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/knowledge-accumulation.json
```

## 4. Learning Efficiency

```bash
# How efficiently does the system learn? (success rate gain per execution)
jq -s '
  map(select(.estimated_metrics.execution_count >= 5 and .estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient)) | {
    # Learning efficiency: gradient / executions = improvement per execution
    learning_efficiency_scores: map({
      id: .id,
      efficiency: (.estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient / .estimated_metrics.execution_count)
    }),
    
    avg_learning_efficiency: (
      map(.estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient / .estimated_metrics.execution_count) | add / length
    ),
    
    # Fast learners (high efficiency)
    fast_learners: (sort_by(-(.estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient / .estimated_metrics.execution_count)) | .[0:3] | map(.id)),
    
    # Learning efficiency score (0-100)
    efficiency_score: (
      (map(.estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient / .estimated_metrics.execution_count) | add / length) * 1000
    ) | if . > 100 then 100 else . end
  }
' ~/.metabob/activities/*.json > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/learning-efficiency.json
```

## 5. Aggregate Learning Depth

```bash
jq -s '{
  pattern_recognition: .[0],
  adaptation_sophistication: .[1],
  knowledge_accumulation: .[2],
  learning_efficiency: .[3],
  
  # Composite learning depth score (0-100)
  learning_depth_score: (
    (.[0].pattern_diversity_score * 2.5) +           # 25%
    (.[1].adaptation_sophistication * 0.25) +        # 25%
    (.[2].knowledge_reuse_score * 0.25) +            # 25%
    (.[3].efficiency_score * 0.25)                   # 25%
  ) | if . > 100 then 100 else . end
}' $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/pattern-recognition.json \
   $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/adaptation-sophistication.json \
   $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/knowledge-accumulation.json \
   $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/learning-efficiency.json > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/learning-depth.json
```

task_steps.description: Detect emergent capabilities and autonomous growth

prompt.template:
Measure emergence indicators and autonomy growth:

## 1. Emergence Indicators

```bash
# Detect capabilities that emerged without explicit design

# Count self-created templates (templates that create templates)
jq -s '
  {
    # Templates with "create" capability
    creator_templates: map(select(.id | contains("create-") or contains("generate-"))) | length,
    
    # Templates with composition capability (using other activities)
    composer_templates: map(select(.task_steps[].prompt.template | contains("activity"))) | length,
    
    # Templates with meta capability (improve themselves)
    meta_templates: map(select(.id | contains("improve") or contains("evolve") or contains("ratchet"))) | length,
    
    # Templates with analysis capability
    analyzer_templates: map(select(.id | contains("assess") or contains("analyze") or contains("measure") or contains("validate"))) | length,
    
    # Emergence score: capabilities beyond basic execution
    emergence_score: (
      (map(select(.id | contains("create-") or contains("generate-"))) | length) * 10 +
      (map(select(.task_steps[].prompt.template | contains("activity"))) | length) * 15 +
      (map(select(.id | contains("improve") or contains("evolve") or contains("ratchet"))) | length) * 25 +
      (map(select(.id | contains("assess") or contains("analyze") or contains("measure") or contains("validate"))) | length) * 5
    )
  }
' ~/.metabob/activities/*.json > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/emergence-indicators.json
```

## 2. Autonomy Metrics

```bash
# Measure system's ability to operate independently

# Check boredom system activity (autonomous improvement triggers)
if [ -f ~/.local/share/opencode/boredom-activity-log.json ]; then
  jq '{auto_triggers_30d: length}' ~/.local/share/opencode/boredom-activity-log.json
else
  echo '{"auto_triggers_30d": 0}'
fi > /tmp/boredom_triggers.json

# Check for autonomous git commits (from activities)
cd ~/.metabob/activities
git log --since="30 days ago" --author="opencode\|activity\|metabob" --oneline | wc -l > /tmp/auto_commits_30d.txt

jq -n --arg triggers "$(cat /tmp/boredom_triggers.json | jq -r '.auto_triggers_30d')" \
      --arg commits "$(cat /tmp/auto_commits_30d.txt)" '
  {
    autonomous_triggers_30d: ($triggers | tonumber),
    autonomous_commits_30d: ($commits | tonumber),
    
    # Autonomy level (0-100)
    autonomy_level: (
      ($triggers | tonumber) * 10 + ($commits | tonumber) * 5
    ) | if . > 100 then 100 else . end,
    
    # Interpretation
    autonomy_status: (
      if (($triggers | tonumber) > 5) then "HIGHLY_AUTONOMOUS"
      elif (($triggers | tonumber) > 0) then "PARTIALLY_AUTONOMOUS"
      else "MANUAL" end
    )
  }
' > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/autonomy-metrics.json
```

## 3. Potential Energy (Capacity for Future Growth)

```bash
# Measure system's capacity for future improvement
jq -s '
  {
    # Untapped potential: templates with low execution but good structure
    underutilized_templates: map(select(.estimated_metrics.execution_count < 5 and .task_steps | length > 2)) | length,
    
    # Optimization headroom: templates with room to improve
    improvable_templates: map(select(.estimated_metrics.success_rate < 0.90 and .estimated_metrics.execution_count > 5)) | length,
    
    # Composability: templates that can be combined
    composable_templates: map(select(.category == "infrastructure" or .id | contains("create") or contains("validate"))) | length,
    
    # Extensibility: templates with good structure for variants
    extensible_templates: map(select(.task_steps | length >= 3 and (.task_steps[].validation.required_patterns | length > 0))) | length,
    
    # Potential energy score
    potential_energy_score: (
      (map(select(.estimated_metrics.execution_count < 5 and .task_steps | length > 2)) | length) * 5 +
      (map(select(.estimated_metrics.success_rate < 0.90 and .estimated_metrics.execution_count > 5)) | length) * 10 +
      (map(select(.category == "infrastructure" or .id | contains("create") or contains("validate"))) | length) * 3
    )
  }
' ~/.metabob/activities/*.json > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/potential-energy.json
```

## 4. Aggregate Emergence & Autonomy

```bash
jq -s '{
  emergence_indicators: .[0],
  autonomy_metrics: .[1],
  potential_energy: .[2],
  
  # Overall becoming capacity score
  becoming_capacity_score: (
    (.[0].emergence_score * 0.3) +                  # 30%
    (.[1].autonomy_level * 0.4) +                   # 40%
    (.[2].potential_energy_score * 0.3)             # 30%
  ) | if . > 100 then 100 else . end
}' $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/emergence-indicators.json \
   $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/autonomy-metrics.json \
   $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/potential-energy.json > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/emergence-autonomy.json
```

## Generate Full Report

```bash
cd $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR

jq -s --arg timestamp "$(date -Iseconds)" '
  # Calculate overall velocity
  . as $data |
  (($data[0].composite_velocity_score * 0.35) +
   ($data[1].learning_depth_score * 0.35) +
   ($data[2].becoming_capacity_score * 0.30)) as $overall |
  
  # Format markdown with all data
  # [Full template interpolation]
  
' change-velocity.json learning-depth.json emergence-autonomy.json > BECOMING_VELOCITY_REPORT.md

# Add philosophical closing
echo "\n---\n\n*To measure becoming is to participate in it. By observing our velocity, we accelerate it.*" >> BECOMING_VELOCITY_REPORT.md
```
